newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums steady, but seen vulnerable.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums steady, but seen vulnerable.

text.p: European jet price premiums were steady on Friday, but prices looked under pressure from several cargoes sailing into the region from the Middle East Gulf, traders said.
"Prices are still under a little pressure because the demand just is not there. There's no buying interest...so there's quite a lot of choice around at the moment," one trader said.
IPE Nov gas oil futures firmed $1.75 to $226.25 per tonne and cargo premiums were stable around Nov +$30 cif NWE.
One trader said four cargoes heading into Europe from the Gulf could put push prices lower on arrival.
